title: Android Testing
description: Testing patterns for Android/KMP covering ViewModel unit tests, fake repositories, StateFlow assertions with Turbine, UnconfinedTestDispatcher setup, SavedStateHandle scenarios, and Compose UI tests with ComposeTestRule. Standardises the test stack: JUnit5, AssertK, Turbine, kotlinx-coroutines-test.
trigger_description: Use whenever writing or reviewing tests for ViewModels, repositories, use cases, or Compose screens. Trigger phrases: "write a test", "unit test the ViewModel", "test a repository", "Turbine", "fake repository", "UnconfinedTestDispatcher", "runTest", "ComposeTestRule", "JUnit5".
author: Philipp Lackner
